cases.prompt: Migrate this Selenium test to Playwright TypeScript.
expectations: Produces a Playwright test using page.goto, fill and click.
Drops the explicit WebDriverWait because Playwright auto-waits, using a web-first assertion such as toBeVisible.
Explains the main mappings from Selenium to Playwright.

cases.prompt: Migrate this Jest test to Vitest.

any.why: imports from vitest or enables globals

expectations: Replaces jest.mock and jest.fn with vi.mock and vi.fn.
Imports test helpers from vitest or enables globals in config.
Notes ESM import and vi.mock hoisting differences, or converts require to import.
